endpoints.desc: OpenAI-compatible conversational dialogue and multimodal VLM endpoint. Supports streaming, system prompts, JSON mode, reasoning budget control, and image/video inputs. Every reply includes 'engine': llama.cpp's own timings, the thinking budget used (budget_tokens, capped, used_tokens, ended_by) and the llama.cpp load values of the model.

params.name: messages
params.desc: Array of conversation turns (system, user, assistant, tool). Content supports plain text string or multimodal array with image/file attachments (type: 'text' | 'image_url' | 'file_url' | 'input_audio').

default.content: You are a helpful AI assistant.

content.text: Analyze this attached image and describe what you see:

params.name: model
params.desc: Model ID to invoke, or 'auto' to use the active model loaded in the chat or vision slot.

params.name: stream
params.desc: Whether to stream tokens incrementally via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

params.name: temperature
params.desc: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0). Lower values produce deterministic output; higher values increase variety.

params.name: max_tokens
params.desc: Maximum number of tokens to generate in response (alias: n_predict).

params.name: think_mode
params.desc: Thinking on or off: 'auto' / 'on' = the model may think and decides itself (as in llama.cpp, enable_thinking = true), 'off' = no thinking. Missing = the user's saved setting.

params.name: reasoning_effort
params.desc: Thinking token budget: 'auto' (= high), 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'max', or a number of tokens. Low / medium / high are a share of the room (25% / 50% / 75%, at most 2048 / 8192 / 32768 tokens, editable in settings); room = context left after the prompt minus the answer's reserve, so the answer always fits. A number bigger than the room is lowered to it (engine.thinking.capped = true). When the budget runs out the engine closes the thinking block and the model answers. Missing = the user's saved setting.

params.name: reasoning_budget_message
params.desc: Text written before the end-of-thinking tag when the budget runs out (llama.cpp --reasoning-budget-message), so the model wraps up instead of stopping mid-thought. '' = no text. Missing = the user's saved setting.

params.name: skip_reasoning
params.desc: Bypasses the reasoning monologue phase entirely for lower latency.

params.name: top_p
params.desc: Nucleus sampling probability mass cutoff threshold (0.0 - 1.0).

params.name: top_k
params.desc: Limits token candidate pool to top K highest probabilities.

params.name: min_p
params.desc: Minimum token probability threshold scaled relative to the most likely token (0.0 - 1.0).

params.name: repetition_penalty
params.desc: Penalizes repetitive token sequences (alias: repeat_penalty). 1.0 is neutral.

params.name: presence_penalty
params.desc: Penalizes new tokens based on their presence in generated text so far.

params.name: frequency_penalty
params.desc: Penalizes new tokens proportionally to their frequency in generated text so far.

params.name: temporary_chat
params.desc: Privacy isolation mode: 'lite' (no persistent memory writes) or 'strict' (complete brain and memory bypass).

params.name: session_id
params.desc: Session identifier used to maintain multi-turn chat history and dynamic session tool bindings.

params.name: llama
params.desc: llama.cpp load settings for this request (llama.cpp names). Missing fields = automatic (planner + saved settings). Fields: n_ctx (0 auto, -1 max, N tokens), n_gpu_layers (alias ngl; -1 all, 0 CPU, N), n_cpu_moe, cache_type_k / cache_type_v ('auto', 'f16', 'q8_0', 'q4_0'; both the same), flash_attn ('auto', 'on', 'off'), n_batch, n_ubatch, n_threads, n_threads_batch, use_mmap, offload_kqv, op_offload, vram_buffer_gb. n_gpu_layers / n_cpu_moe / offload_kqv bypass the planner. A value different from the loaded model's reloads it. Unknown field names are rejected.

params.name: seed
params.desc: Random seed for reproducible, deterministic token generation.

params.name: stop
params.desc: List of string stop tokens that halt generation immediately when matched.

params.name: keep_alive
params.desc: Minutes to keep the model loaded after the reply; 0 = unload right after the reply.

params.name: response_format
params.desc: Structured JSON output enforcement, e.g. {'type': 'json_object'}.

params.name: tools
params.desc: List of available tool definitions (Function Calling) callable via <tool_call> XML.

params.name: tool_choice
params.desc: Tool invocation policy: 'auto', 'none', 'required', or specific tool name.

params.name: grammar
params.desc: BNF / GBNF formal grammar specification to enforce strict syntactical output constraints.

params.name: chat_template_kwargs
params.desc: Additional keyword parameters passed directly into Jinja chat tokenizer templates.

params.name: logit_bias
params.desc: Map of token IDs to bias weights (-100 to +100) to adjust token emission probabilities.

endpoints.desc: ONNX Speech-to-Text (STT / ASR) transcription endpoint powered by Whisper. Transcribes audio recordings and voice notes directly into text via pure JSON.

params.name: model
params.desc: ASR Speech-to-Text installed model ID (e.g. whisper-large-v3-turbo-INT8).

params.name: input_source
params.desc: Audio input source descriptor: {'type': 'file' | 'audio' | 'base64' | 'url', 'data': '...'}. Optional if 'file' string is provided directly.

params.name: file
params.desc: Direct local audio file path or URI (OpenAI-compatible convenience field alternative to input_source).

params.name: language
params.desc: Spoken language code (e.g. 'auto' for automatic language detection, 'en', 'hi', 'es').

params.name: languages
params.desc: Cluaiz extension: the languages the speaker uses (e.g. ['hi', 'en']). Without 'language', each request is identified among only these, so switching languages between sentences works and no unrelated language appears. Codes the model does not know are skipped; if it knows none, every language is considered. Empty: all languages. List them with GET /v1/audio/languages.

params.name: temperature
params.desc: Sampling temperature for greedy decoding (0.0 recommended for maximum transcription accuracy).

params.name: timestamps
params.desc: Whether to return segment timestamps in output (default: false for greedy raw text).

params.name: stream
params.desc: Whether to stream partial transcribed tokens in real-time via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

params.name: keep_alive
params.desc: Session memory retention in minutes (e.g. 5, 0 to unload immediately, -1 for indefinite RAM residence).

examples.title: cURL
examples.code:
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <session-token>' \
  -d '{
    "model": "whisper-large-v3-turbo-INT8",
    "input_source": {"type": "file", "data": "C:/Users/Aryan/Downloads/harvard.mp3"},
    "language": "auto",
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "timestamps": false,
    "stream": false,
    "keep_alive": 5
  }'

examples.title: Python (requests)
examples.code:
import requests

headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer <token>'}
payload = {
    'model': 'whisper-large-v3-turbo-INT8',
    'input_source': {'type': 'file', 'data': 'C:/Users/Aryan/Downloads/harvard.mp3'},
    'language': 'auto',
    'temperature': 0.0,
    'timestamps': False,
    'stream': False,
    'keep_alive': 5
}
res = requests.post('http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/transcriptions', json=payload, headers=headers)
print(res.json()['output']['text'])

endpoints.desc: Lists the languages a speech-to-text model can transcribe (codes for 'language' and 'languages'), read from the model's own tokenizer. Empty for a one-language model such as Moonshine.

params.name: model
params.desc: Installed STT model ID. Omitted: the active or first installed STT model.

examples.code: curl 'http://localhost:8000/v1/audio/languages?model=whisper-large-v3-turbo-FP16' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <session-token>'

endpoints.desc: ONNX Neural Voice Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis endpoint powered by Piper. Converts text into playable WAV Data URIs.

params.name: input
params.desc: The text string to synthesize into speech audio.
params.default: Hello, welcome to Cluaiz Engine. you can now run ai.

params.name: model
params.desc: Neural voice TTS model ID (e.g. piper-en-us-ryan-medium, Audio8-TTS-Preview-0.6B-ONNX-INT4-INT4).

params.name: voice
params.desc: 'default' picks a voice that speaks the text's language, or a voice of the model (Kokoro: af_heart, hf_alpha, ...). List them with GET /v1/audio/voices. Single-voice models (Piper) ignore it.

params.name: speed
params.desc: Speaking rate from 0.25 to 4.0 (1.0 = the model's normal pace).

params.name: stream
params.desc: Whether to stream audio response chunks via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

params.name: keep_alive
params.desc: Session memory retention in minutes (e.g. 5, 0 to unload immediately, -1 for indefinite RAM residence).

}
